notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite and Crystalline Crawler each have at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Viral Drake by paying {3}{U}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite and Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
